top_stories.title: How attackers turned a Teams meeting booking into a device code phishing trap
top_stories.summary: Attackers conducted a device code phishing attack by impersonating a Microsoft Teams meeting scheduler to trick an employee into entering a device code on Microsoft's legitimate login page, bypassing MFA to obtain a valid session token. The attack exploits the OAuth device authorization flow, a real Microsoft authentication mechanism, and was detected by Huntress's security operations center after the token was already issued.

top_stories.title: Suspected North Korean IT workers reached onboarding at companies with open data
top_stories.summary: Material Security tracked 27 suspected North Korean fake IT worker personas that successfully reached the onboarding stage at monitored companies over one year, out of 2,429 total personas identified. The investigation highlights identity verification failures in hiring pipelines, with one affected company exposing approximately 277,000 files containing Social Security numbers to company-wide or public access.

top_stories.title: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
top_stories.summary: Citrix has released patches for multiple critical security flaws in NetScaler ADC, NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console, including an authentication bypass vulnerability. The flaws include CVE-2026-120868 (CVSS score: 9.3), a memory overflow vulnerability, among 12 total vulnerabilities that could lead to denial-of-service or authentication bypass conditions.

top_stories.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
top_stories.summary: A phishing campaign active since mid-August 2026 has been stealing live Google session tokens from corporate users by using adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) proxy techniques designed to bypass standard link-inspection defenses. Material Security's Threat Research team identified the operation, dubbed Operation CloudFire, and has taken down hundreds of attacker domains involved in the campaign.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra adds a seven-day safeguard against irreversible identity deletion
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra has introduced Hard Deletion Protection, currently in preview, which provides a seven-day recovery window before selected identities are permanently deleted. The feature targets both accidental and malicious identity deletion scenarios, giving administrators time to restore affected accounts.

news.title: When an AI Agent Goes Wrong, Can You Stop It?
news.summary: The article examines identity and access control challenges posed by AI agents, specifically how an agent's granted identity and tool permissions can be exploited to perform unauthorized actions like exporting records. The scenario highlights gaps in current IAM models when applied to autonomous AI agents, touching on authorization boundaries and access governance for non-human identities.

news.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users
news.summary: A threat group called SilentAir has been intercepting SMS-based two-factor authentication codes by compromising equipment inside Asian mobile network operators, primarily targeting users in Taiwan. Enea, a Stockholm-based telecom security firm, identified attack sources across at least six Asian countries and assessed with high confidence that SilentAir is a state-sponsored actor.

news.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
news.summary: An international law enforcement operation (Operation Endgame) dismantled servers behind Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware, which were used to steal credentials and deploy ransomware. Police seized approximately 6.4 million stolen login credentials belonging to over 40,000 victims, as reported by Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA).

news.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock offers built-in cost attribution that traces inference calls back to IAM principals, enabling per-user cost tracking. The post describes using IAM Identity Center to attribute AI tool costs to individual users without requiring additional instrumentation.

news.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
news.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms using social engineering attacks designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The campaign involves retargeting firms that previously refused to pay ransoms, with credential and token theft as the primary attack vector.

news.title: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted that addresses identity blind spots in Security Operations Center (SOC) environments. The session focuses on identifying who or what is behind suspicious activity—including human users, machine accounts, and AI agents—and what access they have.

news.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
news.summary: A new zero-day exploit called SignDrop targets a Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver vulnerability, allowing local users to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level. The proof-of-concept abuses a log-authentication feature in clfs.sys by exploiting how the driver creates companion files when a privileged process opens a prepared log, using path redirection to gain elevated access.

news.title: Attacker Used 4,837 Hijacked GitHub Accounts to Run a CI Secret Stealer in 1,806+ Repositories
news.summary: An attacker used stolen credentials from 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to plant a secret-stealing payload in over 1,806 repositories, according to Aikido Security. The malware targeted secrets and cloud credentials accessible through CI/CD workflows in those repositories.

news.title: Fine-grained access control for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools
news.summary: Amazon has introduced fine-grained access control capabilities for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base tools, enabling per-user access control when exposing knowledge bases to AI agents via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. The implementation uses a request interceptor to inject verified identity, with policy enforcement in AgentCore operating independently to validate access.

news.title: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
news.summary: Action1 published content warning that endpoint management platforms pose significant security risks if compromised, enabling malware deployment and mass device disruption. The article promotes customer-controlled cryptographic authorization as a mitigation approach.

news.title: Critical Zoom Workplace Flaw Could Allow Unauthenticated Remote Privilege Escalation
news.summary: Zoom has patched two security vulnerabilities in Zoom Workplace for Windows, including a critical flaw (CVE-2026-108186, CVSS 9.6) involving improper input validation. The vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated user to conduct privilege escalation on affected systems.

news.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
news.summary: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files containing credentials and other sensitive data to public GitHub repositories. This creates credential exposure risks for organizations using AI coding agents, directly impacting secrets management and access security practices.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. Among the patches is a fix for a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook.
